description: This file defines functions and schemas for fetching and parsing synthetic model data from an external API, including schema validation, data parsing, and error handling.

methods.name: parsePrice
methods.description: Parses a string price value, extracting numeric value and converting to a number of micro-units.

methods.name: parseSyntheticModel
methods.description: Converts a SyntheticModel object into a ModelInfo object, extracting relevant properties and support flags.

methods.name: getSyntheticModels
methods.description: Fetches synthetic models from an external API, validates response, and returns a record of model IDs to ModelInfo objects.
